'''Boriin''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Boriin system/Legends|Boriin system]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] that prohibited skilled metalsmiths from leaving its territories.<ref name="IC 501st">''[[Imperial Commando: 501st]]''</ref>
